title: Cool but...
text: Cool but.... Came with a few chips in the veneer but nothing apparent till I started putting it together. The feet or legs are not sturdy & I need to reinforce them somehow. I’m afraid they’ll buckle under the weight. Also one drawer sits a little high & doesn’t close without (minor) effort. . That being said, I Love the look & color & it fits the space perfectly.

product_metadata.title: Manhattan Comfort Uppsala Series Retro Style Tabletop TV Stand with a 3 Open Shelf Design and 2 Drawers, White Finish
features: PERFECTLY SIZED: The Uppsala When Assembled Measures 53.15"L x 27.36"H x 13.78"D an Weighs Approx. 56 Lbs - The Long Retro Style TV Stand Arrives with Assembly Required

WIDE SHELVES FOR STORAGE: The Stand Has 3 Built In Extra Wide Shelves For Storing Media, Books, Remotes and More On The Right Side, Left Side and Middle. The Stand Also Features 2 Drawers With Built In Ring Holes
UNIQUE SPLAYED ROUNDED LEGS: The TV Stand Features a Unique Set of Rounded Legs Making It Sturdy and Adding a Unique Splayed Leg Design to The Modern Décor, The Splayed Legs Are Well Made and Sturdy

FASHION FURNITURE FOR SMALL SPACES: The Retro TV Stand Is Built To Accommodate Up To a 42" Flat Screen TV on The Top with a Max Weight Capacity of 81 Lbs, The Unique Design Allows It To Add Some Flair To the Living Room
TRUST MANHATTAN COMFORT: We Stand Behind Our Furniture Designed, Developed and Manufactured by Manhattan Comfort Where We Are Committed To Flawless Design and Customer Satisfaction
description: The Uppsala Series by Manhattan Comfort Falls under the Accentuations Collection, a collection inspired by modern minimalist designs mixed with stellar construction materials and unsurpassed quality control. The Uppsala TV stand is built to accommodate up to a 42" flat screen TV and features 3 unique wide shelves for media, books and more. The TV stand also contains 2 large drawers with built in ring holes in order to access them. One storage drawer on the right and one storage drawer on the left. The tv stand sits atop a unique set of splayed legs that provide a sturdy base while providing a some decorative benefits. The can hold up to 81 Lbs. Fashion forward thinking allows this unique piece to enhance almost any interior decor from the bedroom to the office. The TV stand is finished with a Fluorescent and Vibrant Color. Proudly made and manufactured by Manhattan Comfort, Innovative Furniture since 2008
